title: bromus rigidus var. maximus
intro: Bromus rigidus var. maximus, commonly known as hard fescue, is a type of grass plant that belongs to the Poaceae family. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving respiratory issues, and supporting immune function. The therapeutic actions of hard fescue include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. These constituents are responsible for the plant's ability to modulate the immune system, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit antimicrobial properties.
